answer: Sequential delay proofs: each epoch every agent must post a verifiable delay function output computed from that epoch's fresh seed. Steps: the seed is published, the agent runs 30 minutes of repeated squaring that cannot be split across cores, then posts a short proof anyone checks in milliseconds. Every identity is one vertex in the registry and each vertex needs its own core-time, about $0.02 per epoch, so 1,000 fakes burn 2,000 core-hours a day while earning less. Proofs from stale seeds show violet in the audit view and are rejected, so replay fails and clone costs never spiral down.
